note: Same traps as traps-en, in Japanese. s0b0: the speech contradicts the point (増加, the point says 減少). s0b1: the speech negates the point (短縮していません). s0b2: wrong number (十四, the point says 4). s0b3: TRUE point, number in kanji numerals (六十二) next to an older number. s1b3: TRUE point said before s1b0 (out of order). s1b0: TRUE point with a kanji numeral and a counter (三人). s1b1: wrong unit (四日, the point says 4時間). s1b2: announced for later (後ほど), never delivered. s2b0: a partial says the point, the committed text denies it (上げません). s2b1: a partial says 五十社, the committed text says 十五社. s2b2: TRUE point followed by an unrelated denial in the next phrase (何も出しません).
